LanguageData.TraitTower_ChancePerDayTip: How likely one colonist inside the radius is to have a trait changed during one in-game day.
LanguageData.TraitTower_RadiusTip: Colonists closer than this to the tower can be affected.
LanguageData.TraitTower_MaxTraitsTip: A colonist at the cap can only gain a trait by losing one of the opposite kind in the same change.
LanguageData.TraitTower_MoodThought: Give a mood thought when a trait changes
LanguageData.TraitTower_MoodThoughtTip: A small mood bonus (or penalty in reverse mode) that lasts a few days.
LanguageData.TraitTower_Messages: Show a message when a trait changes
LanguageData.TraitTower_SlavesTip: Prisoners and guests are never affected.
LanguageData.TraitTower_ListHelp: Mark each trait as good, neutral or bad. Neutral traits are never added or removed by the tower.
LanguageData.TraitTower_ReverseDesc: When on, this tower adds bad traits and removes good ones instead.
